limitations: Operator authorization narrowly applies to preset shapes; other GIS Objects frozen.
Square/rectangle regular in Web Mercator projected coordinates, not geodesic; degenerate and unsupported boundary-crossing input rejected.
Three anchors, explicit finish via existing polygonFinishDraw; preview locked, undo/cancel available; ordinary edit after save.
Existing seven-decimal sanitizer, storage and create path unchanged.
150 deterministic geometry cases repeated per viewport; no independent case count multiplication. Save/reload and export classification tested, not full reimport.
Synthetic data, isolated Edge emulated viewports; phone manual minimize/restore when needed, no physical devices or universal certification. Independent AI review post-hoc pending.
